$comment: Config for scripts/audits/seo-checks.mjs (docs/SEO-GATE.md). Blank outDir, siteUrl and siteName come from factory.config.json (build.outputDir, https://project.domain, project.brand). Thresholds follow SEOmator's audit where it gives one; budgets catch regressions. An exception needs the check id, the pages, a reason and a reviewed date; it only downgrades a result to 'accepted' (still printed). Never add one to make a real problem go away. Starting defaults [P], tuned per project.

googleSources.$comment: Google's current docs are the source of truth (docs/SEO-GATE.md §5). The strategy and seo gates (gate.mjs check google-sources) fail unless docs/CONTENT-STRATEGY.md and reports/seo.md each have a '## Google sources checked' table listing every page below with the YYYY-MM-DD date it was read, no older than maxAgeDays. Add a page when a rule starts to rest on it; change maxAgeDays only with the owner.
